2608.23235.title: A Multi-Domain and Multi-Task Generative Framework with Explicit Task and Domain Conditioning for Cross-Domain Event Extraction
2608.23235.paper_summary: Event extraction aims to identify event triggers, classify event types, and extract arguments to construct structured event representations. Despite strong in-domain performance, developing models that generalize robustly across domains remains challenging due to variations in contextual expressions and event schemas. Prior unified and multi-task approaches improve in-domain accuracy but exhibit limited flexibility when applied to unseen domains. Even large language model-based methods that provide full event ontologies at inference time often underperform compared to smaller, task-specific fine-tuned models. We propose a unified multi-domain and multi-task training framework that models heterogeneous event schemas within a single model. Our approach introduces domain conditioning signals, jointly with task-specific prompts, enabling dynamic adaptation to dataset-specific schemas without requiring complete event label sets at inference time. The framework supports both pipeline and end-to-end extraction settings, facilitating efficient task- and domain-level transfer. Experiments on diverse event extraction benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves competitive performance, strong cross-domain generalization, and practical scalability, while preserving domain-specific precision.
2608.23235.paper_summary_zh: 事件抽取旨在識別事件觸發器、分類事件類型並提取參數，以構建結構化的事件表示。儘管在特定領域內表現強勁，但由於上下文表達和事件模式的變化，開發能夠在不同領域穩健泛化的模型仍然具有挑戰性。先前的統一和多任務方法提高了特定領域的準確性，但在應用於未見領域時顯示出有限的靈活性。即使是基於大型語言模型的方法，在推理時提供完整的事件本體，與較小的、針對特定任務的微調模型相比，表現往往不佳。我們提出了一個統一的多領域和多任務訓練框架，該框架在單一模型中建模異質事件模式。我們的方法引入了領域條件信號，結合任務特定的提示，使得能夠動態適應數據集特定的模式，而無需在推理時要求完整的事件標籤集。該框架支持管道和端到端的抽取設置，促進了高效的任務和領域級轉移。在多樣的事件抽取基準上的實驗表明，我們的方法實現了具有競爭力的性能、強大的跨領域泛化能力和實際的可擴展性，同時保持了領域特定的精確性。
